name: KNE (Kubernetes Network Emulation)
description: Infrastructure for emulating complex network topologies using Kubernetes and containers. Supports multi-vendor device emulation with gRPC-based topology management.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Container-based network device implementations are central to the architecture, with support for deploying emulated network nodes as Kubernetes pods.

eval_notes: Google-backed Kubernetes-native network lab tool. OpenConfig/gNMI focus makes it ideal for evaluations involving modern network management APIs and multi-vendor interop testing. Used with Ondatra for running feature profile tests on virtual devices.
